literature_proposed.summary: This node is the leaf beyond van Doorn–Tang's range with lpf C(n,k) > n/k written as its two residue conditions: no carry adding k and n−k in base p at every prime p ≤ k (Kummer 1852), and n mod p ≥ k at every prime k < p ≤ ⌊n/k⌋ (no multiple of p among the k factors of the falling factorial). Both are classical and exactly equivalent to the hypothesis they replace; nothing in the literature closes them uniformly in k for n ≥ exp(log²k/(20 log log k)). Van Doorn and Tang (2026) handle n up to that bound, conditionally on BHP, by Konyagin's count of the primes satisfying the second condition; the first condition alone is satisfiable for every k, with (62,6) meeting all of them. Status: open.
